provider: United States Geological Survey,3D Elevation Program
attribution: U.S. Geological Survey,3DEP,TX Central B1 2017 bare-earth DEM. Modified by bounded unstyled F32 export, bilinear centreline sampling, a documented2m noise filter and shared relative datum subtraction.
horizontal_crs: Bounded export EPSG:32614, transformed from unchanged local WGS84 origin/uniform scale
vertical_datum: Metres above the filtered classified-ground road minimum. The identical NAVD88 datum is used by scenery-ground.json. No vertical multiplier.
uncertainty_note: Registered OSM road position and 2m export limit local accuracy; subsequent resurfacing/bumps may differ from the2017 acquisition. The allowances are reconstruction estimates, not the native source accuracy specification.
interpolation: Periodic Gaussian sigma2m, truncated at3sigma, changes source heights by at most0.016m. Linear4m controls with actual raw-sample anchors and measured crest/minimum; no grade clipping or global relief scaling.
marketing_height_review: Actual classified ground gives30.956m relief, independently consistent with officialF1 published30.9m. Operator133/134ft marketing is not used as a road-height multiplier.
limitations: Racing banking/crossfall remains unchanged. Raw6m cross-section differences are retained as diagnostics, not automatically converted to banking because local plan/kerb registration and resurfacing need separate validation.
The road centreline includes root-owned mapped-arc corrections before sampling. No new plan, width, protection or vehicle changes are authored here.
